stem: In what way does the appearance of the water in line 40 contribute to the resolution of the drama?

options.label: A
options.text: It provides Hormiguita with an explanation for why she has been away for so long.

options.label: B
options.text: It causes Hormiguita's parents to explain to Hormiguita what an ant's main job should be.

options.label: C
options.text: It provides a way for Hormiguita to be freed so that she can return home from the forest.

options.label: D
options.text: It causes the sun, cloud, and wind to understand that they should help Hormiguita.
